description: Router3 has an incorrect default gateway, preventing devices behind Router3 from reaching remote network services.

user_ticket.message: Our computer cannot reach the company DNS server, but we are not sure what is causing the connection problem.

expected_behaviour.healthy: PC3 can reach the DNS server at 10.20.3.10.
expected_behaviour.faulty: PC3 cannot reach 10.20.3.10 because Router3 has an incorrect default gateway.
expected_behaviour.recovered: PC3 can reach 10.20.3.10 after Router3's default gateway is restored.
